title: Functoriality of the etale H1 of G_m and the Picard group
statement: Let $X$ be a curve over an algebraically closed field $k$ and $Y$ a curve over an algebraically closed field $k'$ [def-sc-curves] (possibly $k\neq k'$), and let $u:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $c_u:u^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,X}\to\mathbf G_{m,Y}$ be the comparison morphism of abelian sheaves on $Y_{\mathrm{Et}}$ adjoint to the pullback-of-units map $\mathbf G_{m,X}\to u_*\mathbf G_{m,Y}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and let $u^*$ be the cohomology pullback map [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Under the canonical isomorphisms $\operatorname{Pic}(X)\cong H^1(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,X})$ and $\operatorname{Pic}(Y)\cong H^1(Y_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,Y})$ of [lem-sc-h1-gm-pic], the map $H^1(c_u)\circ u^*:H^1(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,X})\to H^1(Y_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,Y})$ corresponds to pullback of invertible modules [def-sc-invertible-module], [def-pc-module-pullback], $[\mathcal L]\mapsto[u^*\mathcal L]$; equivalently, it sends the class of the etale $\mathbf G_{m,X}$-torsor $\underline{\operatorname{Isom}}(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal L)$ to that of $\underline{\operatorname{Isom}}(\mathcal O_Y,u^*\mathcal L)$. In degree zero, under $H^0=\Gamma$ [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-degree-zero], $H^0(c_u)\circ u^*$ is pullback of global units $\mathcal O_X(X)^\times\to\mathcal O_Y(Y)^\times$.

source.place: Lemma 040E (Lemma 21.6.1), together with functoriality of cohomology under pullback

proof.text: By [lem-sc-h1-gm-pic], the class of an invertible module $\mathcal L$ in $H^1(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,X})$ is represented by the etale torsor $T_{\mathcal L}=\underline{\operatorname{Isom}}(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal L)$; [lem-sc-torsor-h1] identifies this torsor class with the corresponding cohomology class.

Let $u^{-1}T_{\mathcal L}$ be the inverse image of the etale sheaf of sets $T_{\mathcal L}$ (sheafified presheaf inverse image, as in [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]), a $u^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,X}$-torsor. Define $\theta:u^{-1}T_{\mathcal L}\to T_{u^*\mathcal L}=\underline{\operatorname{Isom}}(\mathcal O_Y,u^*\mathcal L)$ by sending a local generator $s$ of $\mathcal L$ on an etale $U\to X$, pulled back to an etale $V\to Y$ over $U$, to the generator $1\otimes s$ of $u^*\mathcal L=\mathcal O_Y\otimes_{u^{-1}\mathcal O_X}u^{-1}\mathcal L$ [def-pc-module-pullback] on $V$. For a local unit $f$ one has $1\otimes fs=c_u(f)(1\otimes s)$, so $\theta$ is equivariant along $c_u$, the comparison of the statement (adjoint, via [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], to pullback of units). An equivariant map from a $G$-torsor to a $G'$-torsor along $G\to G'$ induces an isomorphism from the contracted product (Stacks Tag 03AH; local check on a trivializing covering, where both sides are $G'$). Hence $u^{-1}T_{\mathcal L}\wedge^{u^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,X}}\mathbf G_{m,Y}\cong T_{u^*\mathcal L}$.

source.place: Tag 040E (Lemma 21.6.1), pullback of the Isom torsor

proof.text: By clause (1) of [lem-sc-etale-torsor-h1-functoriality], $u^*:H^1(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,X})\to H^1(Y_{\mathrm{Et}},u^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,X})$ sends the class of $T_{\mathcal L}$ (step 1, via [lem-sc-torsor-h1]) to the class of $u^{-1}T_{\mathcal L}$; by clause (2) applied to $c_u$, $H^1(c_u)$ (the map of [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial]) sends that to the class of $u^{-1}T_{\mathcal L}\wedge^{u^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,X}}\mathbf G_{m,Y}$, which is $[T_{u^*\mathcal L}]$ by step 2. Under [lem-sc-h1-gm-pic] for $Y$ this is $[u^*\mathcal L]$, so $H^1(c_u)\circ u^*$ corresponds to $[\mathcal L]\mapsto[u^*\mathcal L]$.

For degree zero, [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-degree-zero] identifies cohomology with global sections and identifies the pullback with the unit map on sections. Applied to $\mathbf G_m$, this is the pullback homomorphism $\mathcal O_X(X)^\times\to\mathcal O_Y(Y)^\times$.
